scope: Retained validation findings for this policy/tooling change; no game grade.

events.cause: The authorized new external-review documentation used a different filename than the initial scope allowlist.

findings: Require canonical C9 attack-matrix assertions in the consumer even when a substituted matrix uses the same attack IDs.
Reject an explicitly non-PASS original or wrapper disposition even when scores and a passed flag conflict with it.
Make current execution metadata identify forward acceptance and the usable current evidence transports.
events.disposition: Supersede the first freeze, retain these findings, and regenerate only after affected tests and the combined suite pass.

events.result: 205 tests run; two positive T12 consistency fixtures failed
events.cause: The aggregate T12 consistency wrapper uses CRITIC_REVIEWS_COMPLETE, while the strengthened current final-critic contract requires explicit PASS and boolean passed=true on critic rows.
events.repair: Retain exact wrapper lifecycle validation separately from policy-binding validation; require each current critic row to supply its own explicit final disposition. Add negative wrapper/per-row interchangeability checks.

events.combined_retest: 206/206 tests passed across18/18groups; no failures, errors or skipped tests.

events.finding: C1/C2 external evidence counted camera labels but accepted identical candidate capture bytes relabeled as multiple views. Independent critic reproduced a false C2 multi-view pass with coherent input/session hashes.
events.repair_scope: Require distinct candidate capture bytes for the declared multi-view coverage; retain actual independent view inspection requirement.
events.retest: Targeted legitimate C1/C2 positive and coherent duplicate-byte negative passed for both critics; combined207/207tests across18/18groups passed with0fail/error/skip.
